name: EV Charging Stations
description: Size the market for public EV charging infrastructure.
formula: TAM = Population x Penetration_rate x Purchase_frequency x Average_spend
solution_logic: Step 1: Identify addressable population = target_population x addressable_segment
Step 2: Apply penetration rate = addressable_population x penetration_rate
Step 3: Calculate annual spend per user = purchase_frequency x avg_spend_per_purchase
Step 4: Calculate TAM = penetrating_users x annual_spend_per_user
key_insight: The population here is registered EVs, not general population or even all drivers -- and "lacking home charging" is the entire reason public charging demand exists.
common_mistakes: Sizing all vehicle owners instead of registered EV owners specifically
Skipping the "lacking home charging" filter, which is the actual driver of public charging demand
Treating charging sessions/year like a subscription instead of a pay-per-use frequency
framework_soundbite: Registered EVs without home charging, times how often they need to charge in public -- that's the real base, not every EV on the road.
business_contexts: an energy company deciding whether to build a national EV charging network
an infrastructure fund evaluating an EV charging operator
question_patterns: An energy utility is deciding whether to invest in a national public EV charging network and wants to size the annual revenue opportunity.

prompts.beginner: Estimate the total addressable market for public EV charging sessions.
prompts.intermediate: An energy utility is deciding whether to invest in a national public EV charging network and wants to size the annual revenue opportunity.
prompts.advanced: A state-backed infrastructure fund is weighing a stake in an EV charging operator whose growth deck cites aggressive adoption assumptions the fund's diligence team has not been able to verify independently. Before signing off, the fund wants its own bottom-up view of the addressable market.
